mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of the joint condition are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST) above 600 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and robust corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with HOUST > 600k are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 index points signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO < 100 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) signals delayed monetary tightening, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of the joint condition are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 index points signals strong supply conditions that support corporate output and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with INDPRO > 105 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
